$comment: PF-70 flaky-test quarantine. Tests listed here still run on every PR in the quarantine (*) jobs, which show on the PR but are not inputs to ci-ok (the blocking gate). Removing an entry and its ci.yml exclude puts the test back in the blocking jobs. Do not skip, delete, or weaken the test. Follow-up cards: PF-76 (M1-AC16), PF-77 (LH mobile TBT/perf), PF-78 (WebKit phone LCP), PF-79 (B-4 idle), PF-80 (Chromium visible-jump).

items.title: M1-AC16 there is no Motion toggle; a saved off value is ignored after reload
items.reason: Flaky again after PF-54: page.evaluate / setting up context timeouts on SwiftShader when a prior full-tier test left a GPU backlog. PF-66 rewrote the assertion (no Motion toggle; saved off is ignored) but the card still seeds this entry.

items.title: Lighthouse mobile total-blocking-time (median <= 150 ms) and categories:performance (min 0.95), which TBT dominates
items.reason: Runner CPU noise on the simulated-throttled mobile run. Same product as a green SHA failed with TBT 495 ms (budget 150) and performance 0.86 (budget 0.95). Blocking mobile LH keeps LCP, CLS, a11y, best-practices, SEO, and size budgets.

items.reason: WebKit phone LCP: under CPU pressure a later still's request started at or before the first still (othersBefore not []). Chromium and Firefox, and the desktop-static viewport, stay in the blocking jobs.
